newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rallying in selective trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rallying in selective trading.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to rise in selective trading of blue chips, brokers said.

They said blue chips such as Bangladesh Lamps, Chittagong Cement and BOC Bangladesh were in demand. "But Apex Tannery, Padma Textile, Beximco Synthetics and Bata Shoe may fall if there is institutional selling," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
The DSE all-share prices index closed 59.74 points or 1.67 percent up at 3,627.01 on a turnover of 595.7 million taka on Saturday.
